messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency-regression / hosted-prod - cluster-a - p95 > 900ms for the last 5m. Paging sigs present. Escalation level: paged
meera: I'm on call and looking. Notified customer success. Any runs on kernel/infra rolled in last 24h?
tom: customer impact: a handful of requests hitting interactive endpoints returning ~1s. We saw some 500s but not widespread yet. Triage group call in 5.
oliver: graphs: p50 from ~80ms -> 130ms, p95 from ~420ms -> 980ms starting ~02:13 UTC. Traffic steady. Attached heatmap and p95 breakdown by route: /generate is worst.
suzanne: reproducing quick host-side metrics now. vmstat snapshot:
```
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ------cpu-----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 5  0      0  243272 32684 684120    0    0   430  1020 1500 3400 25 35  8 32 0
```
suzanne: cs (context switches) spiked ~x4 at 02:13. dmesg shows a couple of "soft lockup" warnings on kswapd on two hosts.
raj: rolling kernel client: we applied a vendor backport last night (kernel 6.4.8 -> 6.4.10-like patches) that included runqueue/cfs fixes for jitter. Could be related.
meera: commands I'm running on an affected worker:
```
ssh host-a
perf record -e context-switches -a -g -- sleep 60
perf script | c++filt | head -n 40
```
mike: I pulled a perf top sample: top kernel symbols are __schedule, context_switch, try_to_wake_up and kswapd_reclaim. Also see heavy time in writeback.
oliver: trace link: https://traces.redwood/trace/4b7c3f - spans show long kernel->io wait between net_rx and tok_enqueue at the time of p95 spikes.
suzanne: hypothesis list (in-thread):
- H1: kernel backport changed wakeup semantics, causing more context-switches and runqueue churn (correlates with deploy window)
- H2: paging / reclaim thrash on these hosts due to a memory pressure regression in the kernel patch
- H3: workload change exposed inefficient batching leading to more KV cache evictions -> more I/O -> higher latency
- H4: unrelated network flapping causing delayed responses (low priority for now)
meera: mitigation steps being tested (live):
- pin new traffic to older hostpool via routing rule (canary fallback)
- bump mem.watermark and disable eager reclaim on affected hosts
- temporary autoscale increase to move load off hot hosts
- revert kernel backport on one canary node
raj: I reverted the kernel on host-canary-01 at 02:36 UTC and we saw p95 drop to ~460ms on that host within 30s. Rolling that revert to 3 more canaries now.
mike: logs attached: s3://redwood-incident/logs/1719998888/host-a/perf.log
oliver: building timeline in the doc: https://docs.redwood/incident/1719998888/rca-draft - please add your findings. I'm adding trace spans and the p50/p95 series.
suzanne: quick perf counter snapshots (before/after revert):
BEFORE:
- context-switches/s: 55k
- runqueue length avg: 8.2
- pagein/s: 420
AFTER (host-canary-01 revert):
- context-switches/s: 12k
- runqueue length avg: 1.3
- pagein/s: 42
meera: customer-facing status: CS updated customers at 02:50 UTC. No data exfiltration. Main impact: latency and a few timeouts for heavy-gen routes.
raj: next steps: finish rolling revert across the affected pool, collect perf samples on pre/post nodes, and confirm if a kernel regression is the root cause. If confirmed, file vendor bug and coordinate revert release.
mike: also adding trace of kswapd samples to the doc. <@suzanne> can you capture ftrace output for the reclaim window?
suzanne: capturing now. running `echo 1 > /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on` and will upload.
meera: thanks. once we have full perf + ftrace + timeline we'll convert to RCA and list mitigation (revert + vendor patch request + auto-pin for 24h). Assigning lead: @suzanne. Eng-sre to follow up for postmortem.
suzanne: taking lead. I'll post final hypothesis score and evidence checklist by EOD.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation shows partial recovery after kernel revert on canaries. Continue updates in-thread. Severity downgraded when p95 below 600ms cluster-wide.
meera: closing live mitigation loop for now. keep thread for RCA notes and artifacts. If any regression after roll, page again.
